deck_context.source_summary: Class28, week6, September23 2026. Traditional AEM Sites on AEM as a Cloud Service. Demo uses local Author SDK only. Configuration and ACL inspection today; subservice mappings and ResourceResolver lifecycle belong to Class29.
canonical_facts: Humans on Cloud Author authenticate through IMS; repository ACLs govern content operations. A service user is a repository identity for code, with no password login.

Demo root /content/training-permissions has guides and outside child folders. training-guide-editors receives read on root and modifyProperties on guides only. training-guide-reader receives read on guides only via resource ACL.
A narrow grant does not remove other grants. everyone, all groups, ancestors, restrictions and direct user entries matter. Deny does not always win in Oak.
Repo Init creates identities and paths before ACLs. Source-controlled author configuration. create path used for broad SDK compatibility; modern Sling prefers ensure nodes.
Local human demo is manually created with an uncommitted password and assigned only to training-guide-editors. No administrators membership.
No Java, HTTP security bypass, cloud deployment or claimed SDK execution. Final page contains only Questions, Thank you. and 12.
